summaries.title: Learning From Mistakes Makes LLM Better Reasoner
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Learning From Mistakes Makes LLM** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、思维链（Chain-of-Thought (CoT)）。核心论点主张：To further improve this capability, this work proposes Learning from Mistakes (LeMa), akin to human learning processes。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **GSM8K, MATH**。实验设计与验证细节：Consider a human student who failed to solve a math problem, he will learn from what mistake he has made and how to correct it。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **85.4%, 27.1%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Impressively, LeMa can also benefit specialized LLMs such as WizardMath and MetaMath, achieving 85.4% pass@1...；This surpasses the SOTA performance achieved by non-execution open-source models on these challenging tasks）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 29 赞），本工作为突破 **思维链与树搜索 (CoT & Search)、数学竞赛与形式化定理证明 (Math & Proof)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
